description: Get the current prices returned by the API for this account in one call. Use when the user wants a broad market snapshot or asks about overall energy prices. Returns available prices grouped by category (oil, gas, coal, refined products, metals, forex) with 24h changes. Supports filtering by category. Dataset access varies by account entitlement. For a single commodity, use opa_get_price instead.

category.description: Filter by commodity category (default: all). Options: oil, gas, coal, refined, metals, forex.

name: opa_market_overview
title: Energy Market Overview
